subject: design/local-execution-logs
statement: Execution diagnostics use .pyxis/logs/<producer> inside the owning repository. The shared runlogs package resolves repository-relative or absolute overrides only within that tree, rejects traversal and symlinked descendants, creates private per-run files, and finds the persistent checkout that owns a linked worker worktree.
intent: Give every diagnostic producer one local storage boundary while keeping shared workitems, decisions, review artifacts, and retained evaluation evidence in Git.
rationale: The operator approved consolidating execution output under ignored .pyxis/logs subdirectories and explicitly retained Carina workitems and other shared state in Git. Credentials, locks, queues, caches, and rate-limit state keep their separate state locations.
fit_criterion: Path tests reject outside-tree overrides, traversal, and symlink escapes; private-file and real Git worktree tests verify safe creation and persistent checkout ownership.

provenance.note: Records the approved log ownership rule and the implemented path resolver.
